tasks.title: 跨外部播放器画面增强的可行性研究
tasks.gap: The feasibility-study scope is complete: a pinned MPV/libplacebo RAVU Lite PoC executed, produced before/after image metrics and 3x1800-frame process/resource measurements. Evidence is synthetic and not a user-perceptual or product-integration claim; PotPlayer injection, WebView, and arbitrary external-player integration remain unsupported/unverified and are outside this research-only task.
tasks.direction: 仅估算研究：比较外部播放器公开插件接口、独立捕获后处理和托管引擎接入的成本，复用合适开源项目；不承诺无内核限制的通用超分。
tasks.acceptance: 形成支持矩阵与一个有可测画质/帧时延/占用的 PoC，再单独评估产品化；本项工时只覆盖研究，不覆盖所有播放器的完整实现。

reviewEvidence.latestVerification: 2026-10-30: RAVU-Lite step1/step2 observed in all three MPV gpu-next/D3D11 trials on RTX 3060 Laptop. Synthetic PSNR 23.7327→23.7801 dB (+0.047), MAE 7.0809→7.2116; median wall/requested frame 6.399→6.651 ms, CPU/frame 2.066→2.630 ms, peak WS 97.75→102.20 MiB, dedicated GPU allocation 26.68→31.00 MiB. Frame timing includes process/context startup; no meaningful visual-improvement claim.
reviewEvidence.productization: Not included: this task completes feasibility research only. The PoC does not inject shaders into PotPlayer or prove a universal player-independent plugin boundary.
